chain_words.nuance: to put two or more things together
to bring together so that they become one unit
to mix elements so they lose their separate character
to join by melting or intense union into one entity
to combine several elements into a single, unified whole

explanation: These words all describe bringing elements together, from simple combining to a complete unification of separate parts.

usage_notes.difference: 'Blend' describes mixing elements so they become harmonious; 'amalgamate' describes forming a single whole from several separate bodies, often institutions.
